CustomText.description: A text display with a required badge that inherits Text from simplified_catalog_v1_0.json.

id.description: The unique identifier for a component, used for both definitions and references within the same surface.

StyledCard.description: A container card that inherits Card from simplified_catalog_v1_0.json and reuses Button's action property.

id.description: The unique identifier for a component, used for both definitions and references within the same surface.

action.description: Defines an interaction handler that can either trigger an agent-side event or execute a local renderer-side function.

child.description: A reference to a single child component ID.

formatBadge.description: Formats a badge label using a template string.

Action.description: Defines an interaction handler that can either trigger an agent-side event or execute a local renderer-side function.

event.description: The event to dispatch to the agent.

name.description: The name of the action to be dispatched to the agent.

userMessage.description: An optional human-readable message describing the action performed by the user, resolved by the renderer and included in the outbound action message.

context.description: A JSON object containing the key-value pairs for the action context. Values can be literals or paths. Use literal values unless the value must be dynamically bound to the data model. Do NOT use paths for static IDs.

oneOf.description: Executes a renderer or agent-side function.

Child.description: A reference to a single child component ID.

ComponentId.description: The unique identifier for a component, used for both definitions and references within the same surface.

@path.description: A JSON Pointer path to a value in the data model.

DynamicNumber.description: Represents a value that can be either a literal number, a path to a number in the data model, or a function call returning a number.

DynamicValue.description: A value that can be a literal, a path, or a function call returning any type.

FunctionCall.description: Invokes a named function, combining common function properties with the catalog function definition.

FunctionCommon.description: Baseline envelope properties common to all function calls. Function-specific argument schemas ('args') are defined individually by each function in the active catalog.

@call.description: The name of the function to call.

catalogId.description: The catalog ID for this function, overriding any surface-level default catalogId.

IndexSystemFunction.description: Returns the 0-based index of the current item when rendering a dynamic list from a template. This function MUST ONLY be available when evaluating template items within a list context.

offset.description: Optional. An offset to add to the 0-based index (e.g., 1 for 1-based indexing). Defaults to 0.
